JEEVA P 
JAVA FULLSTACK DEVELOPER 
         Adress    |    +91 9344760854    |       Email        |       LinkedIn      |      GitHub 
 
PROFILE SUMMARY 
Results-oriented Java Backend Developer with 4 years of hands -on experience in 
building reliable, scalable, and high -performance backend systems. Strong expertise in 
Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API development, with practical exposure to 
microservices-based architectures. Skilled in designing efficient data models, optimizing 
backend performance, and implementing secure authentication mechanisms. Known for 
writing clean, maintainable code and delivering robust solutions aligned with business 
requirements. A proactive team player with a strong focus on continuous improvement 
and system reliability. 
 
EXPERIENCE 
XYZ Technologies 
Senior Java Backend Developer                                                   July 2022 – July 2025                
 Architected and developed backend services using Spring Boot, ensuring scalability 
and maintainability. 
 Built and enhanced REST APIs for critical business functionalities with high 
performance.  
 Implemented secure access control using Spring Security and JWT authentication.  
 Improved system efficiency by optimizing database queries and reducing API latency.  
 Integrated external services and APIs to extend system capabilities.  
 Integrated third-party APIs and handled secure data transactions.  
 Implemented centralized logging, monitoring, and exception handling mechanisms.   
 Guided junior developers and contributed to improving coding standards within the 
team. 
XYZ Technologies 
  Junior Java Developer                                                               July 2022 – July 2025                
 Supported backend development using Java and Spring Boot for enterprise 
applications. 
 Implemented CRUD operations and contributed to REST API development.  
 Assisted in designing and maintaining database schemas using MySQL.  
 Wrote optimized SQL queries for data retrieval and updates.  
 Debugged and resolved application issues, improving overall system stability.  
 Assisted in implementing input validation and basic exception handling.  
 Participated in API testing using Postman and ensured proper response handling.  
 Supported frontend team by providing APIs and resolving integration issues.  
 Followed coding standards and version control practices using Git.  
 Participated in Agile ceremonies like daily stand -ups and sprint discussions.  
 
 
 
SKILLS 
 Programming: Java 
 Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC  
 Backend Expertise: REST API Development, Microservices (Basics)Data Architecture & 
ETL 
 Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL  
 Tools: Postman, Eclipse/STS, VS Code  
 Version Control: Git, GitHub 
 Core Concepts: OOPS, Exception Handling, API Design  
 
PROJECTS 
E-Commerce Backend System – Spring Boot 
 Engineered backend services for managing products, carts, and order workflows.  
 Implemented core features such as cart management, checkout, and order lifecycle 
processing. 
 Designed optimized queries supporting filtering, searching, and pagination.  
 Ensured data integrity using transactional operations.  
 Applied structured validation and centralized exception handling for API reliability.  
 Enhanced scalability and reduced response time through backend optimizations.  
Insurance Management System – Spring Boot 
 Developed APIs for Customer, Policy, and Quotation modules with structured 
architecture.  
 Implemented layered design (Controller, Service, Repository ) for clean code 
separation.  
 Managed complex entity relationships across multiple modules.  
 Utilized DTOs for consistent and structured API responses.  
 Performed API testing and Validation using Postman.  
 
 
EDUCATION 
 Bachelor of Engineering – Mechanical Engineering 
Panimalar Engineering College 
 
 
July 2018 – May 2022 
 
 
 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION  
 Languages: English,Tamil 
 Certifications: Professional Design Engineer (PDE) License, Project Management Tech 
(PMT), Structural Process Design (SPD).
